question: What product did SlideUpLift launch in August 2026?

hits.title: Creatos AI: AI Presentation Maker Built on 40,000+ Slides
hits.snippet: JERSEY CITY, N.J. – Aug. 14, 2026 : SlideUpLift, a presentation platform trusted by more than 100,000 professionals, today announced the launch of Creatos AI, an AI presentation maker built on SlideUpLift’s library of more than 40,000 professionally designed presentation slides. As AI makes it faster to generate presentation content, professionals still face a familiar challenge: producing decks that look polished, stay on brand and remain easy to edit after they are created. Creatos AI is designed around a different starting point. Rather than relying solely on AI to generate presentation design from a blank prompt, it begins with professionally designed slides and uses AI to help users adapt the content, visuals and branding to their needs.
